desc: Read input N, arrays A and B, K, and queries.
Sort A and B to prepare for prefix-based calculations.
Precompute prefix sums `prefA` and `prefB` of the sorted arrays (length N+1).
Implement helper `prefix_sum_le(arr, val, k)` that returns the sum of elements ≤ val in the first k elements of sorted `arr`, using binary search and prefix sums in O(log N).
Implement `calc(X, Y)` with the derived formula using binary searches and prefix sums.
Optimize the inner loops that sum over `cntB` or `cntA` elements (currently O(cnt) per query) to O(log N) total per query, ensuring the solution scales to N=1e5 and K=1e4.
Test the optimized solution on the sample inputs to verify correctness.
Verify the solution handles edge cases (e.g., N=1, all A_i equal, all B_j equal) correctly.
Ensure the solution runs within time limits for worst-case inputs (N=1e5, K=1e4).
